hub.speaker: Former Headman
hub.text: Village's had a bad run. Crops came up wrong two seasons straight. Animals spooked for no cause. And the ledger won't add up. I count it, it comes up short. Count it again, short again. Something's collecting on us. I mean to know what.

text_variants.text: Whatever you find out there, I want to hear it plain. No riddles and no half-truths neither. The witch keeps to the hollow — west, past my fields, where the trees break.
Whatever you did, the air's changed. I can feel it in my knees, and I trust my knees more than most people.
Word's got round about a fight at the hollow. The briars walked off. Briars don't walk off. Whatever spooked them into it, it worked. Ground's all tore up down the hollow's edge.
Talked her to terms, they tell me. Didn't figure that witch for a bargaining sort. But the fields don't seem to mind however you settled it.

options.text: You said you don't truck with witches.
Not much of a headman anymore, is there?
Remind me what needs doing about the witch?
That ledger of yours. Still short?

options._comment: REPORT ROWS all carry heard_flood_ledger beside their route counter: mill_flood_stack has no quest-start gate and basic_cleaning is the PC's STARTING field skill, so a wander into the mill banked flood_prep_done with started_quests empty and this hub then rendered the ask and the answer at once, settling a quest never offered. Stated on all three so a later ungated producer cannot leak either.
options.text: The tally's honest. Somebody's crop failed and they were ashamed of it.
The flood work's done. The count came right in the doing.
Your shortfall had teeth. The granary corner's clear now.

brief.speaker: Former Headman
brief.text: We don't— didn't used to truck with witches. There's one in the old hollow now. Past the fields. Half the village knows it and pretends it don't. Crops fail. Stock spooks. And one of my own stands there mumbling. Somebody else's talk coming out of her mouth. Find out what she wants and end it. However you have to.

witches_topic.speaker: Former Headman
witches_topic.text: Didn't used to truck with witches, I mean. Used to. Then two seasons came up wrong. Everyone's something these days. Even me. I sent someone door to door over a witch. Never walked out there myself.

reported.speaker: Former Headman
reported.text: Handled. Good. I won't ask how. Whatever you did, thank you. Truly. Now there's hay down and rain coming, so I'd best be at it.

authority_topic.speaker: Former Headman
authority_topic.text: There's a new authority in Riverfarm proper now. A real one. The village answers to it, and answers glad. I mind this end of things the old way. I know where the shovels are. Four in the granary, six behind the mill. Six behind the mill. I count them after rain.

favor_recap.speaker: Former Headman
favor_recap.text: The witch keeps to the hollow. West, past my own fields, where the trees give out. Whatever she's owed, you'll have to settle it out there.

text_variants.text: Word from the hollow says it's settled. Come tell me plain. Then I'll stop chewing on it.

flood_brief.speaker: Former Headman
flood_brief.text: River comes up every spring. Every spring we count what we can carry above the line. This year the count's eleven bushels short. There's no thief in this village. That's worse than a thief. Go down to the mill. Walk the tally with the tallyman. Bring me an answer I can live with.

flood_reported_read.speaker: Former Headman
flood_reported_read.text: Ashamed. Three seasons of it. They'd let the village call them thieves first. Unlucky's the harder word out here. Then we don't say the name. Eleven bushels off my own share. The ledger balances. The village can think what it likes.

flood_reported_worked.speaker: Former Headman
flood_reported_worked.text: You did a week of my people's week in a day. The count came right. Somebody finally stood in that shed long enough. Saw all of it at once. Me, I count from the doorway. There's sacks at the back I've never once shifted.

flood_reported_cleared.speaker: Former Headman
flood_reported_cleared.text: Teeth. Eleven bushels of teeth. I'd rather it was vermin than a neighbour and I'm not proud of that either. Take something off the field board. And don't tell me what you found down there again.
